title: Colombian Arepas de Queso (Cheesy Corn Cakes)
summary: Precooked corn flour is kneaded with warm water, melted butter, mozzarella and queso fresco, shaped into thick discs and cooked slowly on a dry griddle until deeply golden.
equipment: large heavy griddle or frying pan

ingredients.item: precooked white corn flour (masarepa, such as P.A.N.)
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Make the dough
steps.text: Mix the corn flour and sugar in the bowl. Add the warm water gradually, mixing with your fingers, then work in the melted butter and salt. Knead into a soft dough.

steps.title: Add the cheese
steps.text: Knead in the mozzarella and queso fresco in two additions until evenly speckled and smooth; add 1 tbsp water if it feels dry. Cover with the damp towel and rest for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Divide into 8 portions (about 135 g each), roll into balls and pat each into a 10 cm disc about 1.5 cm thick.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Heat the griddle over medium-low heat; no oil is needed. Cook in batches for 7-8 minutes per side until deeply golden, with crisp cheese edges, and hot right through.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top each with a little butter and serve straight away.

tips: Keep the heat medium-low so the inside heats through before the cheese burns.
Taste a crumb of your queso fresco: if it is very salty, skip the added salt.
They are also good split and filled with scrambled eggs for breakfast.
storage: Best eaten hot. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour for up to 3 days and reheat in a dry pan until piping hot. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
